title: Run the OTA API and worker locally with the demo OTA
caption: From docs/mvp/local-development.md §2-§3 and ota/backend/README.md §6. Development only: every password and key here is a committed development value or generated locally.

steps.title: Machine prerequisites
steps.body: PostgreSQL 16 and Redis 7 (native, no Docker), Node 24, pnpm, Mailpit. Run `bash deploy/scripts/dev-setup.sh` once (roles `velexis_ota_app`/`dev_ota`, `velexis_provisioner`/`dev_provisioner`, Redis password `dev_redis`; development only), then `pnpm install`.
steps.expect: The script ends with its summary; every role logs in.

steps.title: Keys and env file
steps.body: `pnpm dev:keys` (creates `.local/keys/` with `master-v1.key`, `api-key-pepper`, `document-url.key`, `ota-jwt-ed25519.pem`, mode 0600, and `.local/storage/`), then `cp ota/backend/.env.example ota/backend/.env.local`.

steps.title: Migrate platform and reference
steps.expect: Schemas `platform` and `reference` filled (airports, airlines, countries, currencies).

steps.title: Start Mailpit and the Amadeus stub
steps.expect: Mailpit UI opens; the stub answers 404 on unknown paths (it has no health route).

steps.title: Seed the platform, then the demo OTA
steps.body: `pnpm --filter @velexis/platform-backend dev:seed` then `pnpm --filter @velexis/ota-backend dev:seed`. **Copy the three keys printed once**: `Publishable test key`, `Secret test key`, `Console automation test key`.
steps.expect: Tenant `demo` (`tenant_demo`, "Demo Travel") active on `demo.ota.example.com`, with an Amadeus test connection (office DEV1A00xx), a `velexis` Stripe test connection, and the keys. A second run changes nothing and prints no keys.

steps.title: Start API and worker
steps.expect: `{"status":"ok","checks":{"postgres":"ok","redis":"ok"}}`; http://127.0.0.1:4001/health/ready adds `queues` with waiting counts per OTA queue.

steps.title: First call
steps.expect: The demo OTA's brand ("Demo Travel"), currencies, payment methods: `card` only when both Stripe test variables hold real test keys (the `_replace_me` dummies copied from `.env.example` count as unset); `airline_card` only for the storefront edge, with `AIRLINE_CARD_ENABLED=true` and the storefront switch on (never through a `pk_` key).

steps.title: Optional: the storefront in a browser
steps.body: `pnpm --filter @velexis/ota-frontend dev`: Vite on 5173 proxies `/api` to 4000 with `X-Velexis-Edge` and `X-Velexis-Host: demo.ota.example.com`.
steps.expect: The demo storefront with a permanent "Test mode" banner.
